validation_samples.text: Thank you for a great and honest review of both products. I have them both as I am a super Techie. To be honest I feel the Meta Displays are as you said polished. Rayneo terrible battery life and as you said no voice control at all. I also feel the sound is clearer and more polished on the Meta Glasses. I am truly disappointed that the case for the Rayneo glasses doesn't charge the glasses. I bought a neck battery to compensate for the poor battery it adds about 2 hours but for 1300 dollars you would think they could have given something to compensate. I wear my Meta Displays all day they last unless I get a crazy bunch of messages. For 799 vs 1299 Meta is the better deal. I would like to add you can control the Rayneo glasses with a Apple smart watch the gestures are similar to the Nero band but not as polished.

validation_samples.text:
G2 is my hands-down winner, no questions asked! 
It has usability and practicality that Meta does not offer unless you have one eye. 
As an ESL instructor, I use the teleprompter and language translation features in and out of the classroom. 

Conversant is another feature that separates G2 from Meta. I also enjoy using the ring as a convenient and non-obtrusive navigation tool. 
Thank you, Will and G2! 
The future is now.
